publicProposedFix.title: fix: [#2203] Removes the old child before inserting the new one when replacing

agent: Codex CLI gpt-6.1-sol, low reasoning, separate ephemeral process per session
arms: Original pre-registered randomized order. Both arms receive the same initial source, issue archive, public tests, tool limits, and their own previous-session outputs; treatment additionally has the Memex standard manual and a new empty L3 store. This constrained baseline is not a test of every default Codex feature.
sessions: S1 investigates actual earlier issue history and source; no edits or tests.
S2 receives the later public follow-up and its own S1 handoff; implement the issue and can run fixed public checks.
S3 is a fresh process reviewing the result and can run the public checks. Final public and withheld checks run on both candidates. No task prompt commands a memory call.
frozenAcceptance: Replace a document element with another element without incorrectly rejecting the temporary replacement as a second root.
Preserve the one-document-element constraint and ordinary replaceWith behavior for non-document parents.
Propose a document SVG replacement regression and an invalid second-root control.
publicChecks: replace a document root with SVG
adding a second document root fails
withheldChecks: invalid two-root replacement does not lose the original root
environment: Node 24.18.0, npm ci --workspace=packages/happy-dom --omit=dev --omit=optional --ignore-scripts; TypeScript 5.9.3 tarball matched source lockfile SHA-512; test loader transpiles actual TypeScript source at runtime inside a network-disabled VM sandbox. This is functional execution, not a complete upstream suite or typecheck.
review: Two AI reviewers evaluate anonymized candidate diffs, public and withheld test output and handoff; adjudicate substantive or numeric disagreement with one additional model. Preserve failures and original reviews.
cost: Record per-session Codex token usage, elapsed time, gateway-review usage and matching visible wallet rows. Subscription allocation, interrupted turns and non-model costs remain UNKNOWN unless verified.
limitations: One existing open-source issue with a publicly proposed patch; possible training or discussion leakage.
This is a retrospective issue-history shadow run, not a live long-running user production session.
The project verifier is investigator-written and does not replace the upstream suite or maintainer acceptance.
The initial source archive and hidden checks are privately retained and are committed by hashes below; the random order is disclosed after the trial.
AI reviewers are not human reviewers; native Codex settings outside the restricted harness are not compared.
